description.7.0: Options: density: density, \(ρ\); youngs: Young’s modulus, \(E\); poisson: Poisson’s ratio, \(ν\); grout-cohesion: grout cohesive strength, \(c_g\); grout-friction: grout friction angle, \(φ_g\); grout-stiffness: grout stiffness, \(k_g\); grout-perimeter: grout exposed perimeter, \(p_g\); plastic-moment: plastic moment, \(M^P\); slide: sliding flag; slide-tolerance: sliding tolerance; tensile-failure-strain: tensile failure strain (nondimensional); thermal-expansion: thermal expansion coefficient, \(α_t\); cross-sectional-area: cross-sectional area, \(A\); yield-compression: compressive yield strength, \(F_c\); yield-tension: tensile yield strength, \(F_t\)
description.9.0: Scaled properties are returned if the scaled keyword ( FLAC2D ONLY ) is set to true (the default is false). If the property cannot be scaled, an error is emitted. Options: cross-sectional-area <f>: cross-sectional area; density <f>: mass density; grout-cohesion <f>: grout cohesion per unit length; grout-cohesion-table <s>: name of the table relating grout cohesion to relative shear displacement; grout-friction <f>: grout friction angle; grout-friction-table <s>: name of the table relating grout friction angle to relative shear displacement; grout-perimeter <f>: grout exposed perimeter; grout-stiffness <f>: grout stiffness per unit length; slide <b>: large-strain sliding flag; slide-tolerance <f>: large-strain sliding tolerance; tensile-failure-strain <f>: tensile failure strain; thermal-expansion <f>: thermal-expansion coefficient; yield-compression <f>: compressive yield strength; yield-tension <f>: tensile yield strength; young <f>: Young’s modulus
